name: file_diagnostics
description: What a language server says is wrong in a file: the errors and warnings, as `path:line:col: error: message [source code]`, sorted by line, a page of at most 100 (the last line says `[more: ... offset=N]` or `[end: ...]`). A server for Rust, TypeScript and JavaScript, Python or Go runs in the workspace's environment and is kept between calls: the first call on a project starts it and may wait for it to index (`wait` seconds, 1 to 120, default 30; a first line says when it is still indexing, and the next call finds it warm). Nothing is changed. Where the environment has no server the answer says so: use run_checks or run_command. Example: {"path":"src/lib.rs"}

path.description: The file, relative to the worktree root (.rs, .ts .tsx .js .jsx, .py, .go)

repo.description: The slot the file is in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a server that is still indexing, 1 to 120 (default 30)
